Package Server

Class EmailService

java.lang.Object
Server.EmailService
public class EmailService extends Object
sends real notification emails through Gmail's SMTP server (STARTTLS on port 587).

credentials are read once from the /db.properties classpath resource (mail.sender, mail.password, mail.host, mail.port). mail.password must be a Gmail App Password, not the normal account password.

sendEmail(String, String, String) dispatches each message on a short-lived daemon thread so the SMTP round-trip never blocks the OCSF request handlers. failures are logged to stdout and swallowed; a notification email never breaks the booking flow.

    • loadConfig

      private static void loadConfig()

    • sendEmail

      public static void sendEmail(String toEmail, String subject, String body)
      sends a plain-text email via Gmail SMTP with STARTTLS. the actual send happens on a daemon thread, so this method returns immediately and never blocks the caller. if configuration or the recipient is missing the call is skipped silently (logged to stdout).
      Parameters:
      toEmail - the recipient address; ignored if null or blank
      subject - the email subject line
      body - the plain-text message body
